summary: Frontend-only regression on the v3 INTL Shipments redesign (slim header with clickable text-stat filters, board card with borderless search + quiet stage chips + 7-column table + unanswered message line + hover Reply/Ignore, footer totals, detail + open orders). All flows from the review request pass at 1920x1080 and 390x844 with zero console/page errors and no horizontal overflow.

attn_flow.is-attn-ignore-IS-0010_decrements: 2 awaiting reply -> 1 awaiting reply; is-attn-IS-0010 removed

verification_details.create_modal: is-create-modal opens; fill is-form-customer + is-form-factory; is-form-submit creates IS-0013 and navigates to intl-shipment-detail

critical_code_review_comments: IntlShipmentsPage.tsx is 417 lines with SEED data, List, Detail, Factories drawer, and Create modal in one file — consider splitting Detail and SEED into their own modules for maintainability.
unanswered() is recomputed on every render for every shipment; fine at current N=3 but worth memoizing or precomputing a Set<id> for larger lists.
The keydown Escape handler only exists in Detail; the create modal and factories drawer are not closable via Escape (only backdrop click or .is-x). Minor UX inconsistency.
seed_data_creation: Transient shipment IS-0013 (TEST_Cust / TEST_Fac) created via create modal — in-memory only
context_for_next_testing_agent: All v3 redesign flows verified. Header stats (is-kpi-all, is-kpi-released, is-attn-group-message) act as toggle filters. Stage chip filters (is-stage-<id>) toggle-on-click. is-clear-filters appears whenever any filter/search is active. Escape does NOT close create modal / factories drawer — use .is-x.
